toml:
# LEO-PNT vertical: the autonomous-vehicle urban canyon, as a flat cut-off and as a street.
#
# The `leo-vertical-autonomous-vehicle` urban canyon twice over: once as that campaign's flat
# 35 deg elevation cut-off (the phase copied unchanged) and once as a street, the
# `city-street` skyline preset turned to run east along the car's heading
# (`street_az_deg = 90`) over a 10 deg receiver mask. The street is 20 m between 30 m walls
# with the antenna 1.5 m up, so the walls rise to 70.7 deg across it and fall to the mask
# along it. Each phase runs the same `leo-pvt` joint fix (GPS, Galileo and a generic low
# Earth orbit (LEO) layer of 240 satellites at 1080 km, 53 deg, 0.25 m signal-in-space range
# error) against the 1.5 m lane-level threshold, and a `leo-pass` run of one LEO pass seen
# from the car. The existing campaign is not changed, so its outputs stay byte-identical.
#
# What the run shows: the flat cut-off keeps 8 GPS and Galileo satellites (mean GNSS-only
# error 5.8 m); the street keeps 4 to 5 of them, the ones along it or high overhead (mean
# 7.3 m, no GNSS-only fix at 2 of 90 epochs), and 1 to 4 LEO satellites against 4 to 5. The
# fused mean error is 2.1 m in both, and the alarm is raised at about 51 % of the flat-cut
# epochs and 59 % of the street epochs. A single cut-off and a street of the same severity
# are not interchangeable: the street keeps fewer satellites but along one axis.
#
# The skyline preset is REPRESENTATIVE (provenance in docs/SKYLINE.md and `kshana skyline
# --preset city-street`), not a survey of any Munich street. Line of sight only: no
# multipath, diffraction or non-line-of-sight reception. MODELLED.
kind = "campaign"
title = "Autonomous vehicle in an urban canyon: a flat cut-off and a city-street skyline"
seed = 20260929

[timeline]
step_s = 10.0

[[phases]]
name = "urban-canyon"
duration_s = 900.0

[[phases.runs]]
series = [
  { channel = "gnss_error_m", unit = "m", t = "joint.epochs[].t_s", y = "joint.epochs[].error_gnss_m" },
  { channel = "position_error_m", t = "joint.epochs[].t_s", y = "joint.epochs[].error_fused_m" },
  { channel = "gnss_in_view", unit = "count", t = "joint.epochs[].t_s", y = "joint.epochs[].n_gnss" },
  { channel = "leo_in_view", unit = "count", t = "joint.epochs[].t_s", y = "joint.epochs[].n_leo" },
]
alarms = [{ channel = "position_error_m", compare = "above", threshold = 1.5 }]
[phases.runs.scenario]
kind = "leo-pvt"
mode = "joint"
seed = 3
duration_s = 900.0
step_s = 10.0
[phases.runs.scenario.user]
lat_deg = 48.137
lon_deg = 11.575
height_m = 520.0
[[phases.runs.scenario.system]]
name = "GPS"
preset = "gps-baseline"
cn0_dbhz = [35.0, 45.0]
sisre_m = 0.6
mask_deg = 35.0
[[phases.runs.scenario.system]]
name = "Galileo"
preset = "galileo"
cn0_dbhz = [35.0, 45.0]
sisre_m = 0.3
isb_ns = 12.0
mask_deg = 35.0
[[phases.runs.scenario.system]]
name = "Generic LEO"
role = "leo"
carrier_hz = 1191.795e6
chip_rate_hz = 10.23e6
cn0_dbhz = [45.0, 58.0]
sisre_m = 0.25
isb_ns = 25.0
mask_deg = 35.0
[[phases.runs.scenario.system.shell]]
total = 240
planes = 12
phasing = 1
altitude_km = 1080.0
inclination_deg = 53.0

[[phases.runs]]
series = [
  { channel = "leo_pass_elevation_deg", unit = "deg", t = "satellites[0].series[].t_s", y = "satellites[0].series[].elevation_deg" },
]
[phases.runs.scenario]
kind = "leo-pass"
epoch = "2026-09-28T08:00:00"
duration_s = 900.0
step_s = 10.0
[phases.runs.scenario.user]
environment = "ground"
lat_deg = 48.137
lon_deg = 11.575
height_m = 520.0
speed_m_s = 14.0
heading_deg = 90.0
mask_deg = 35.0
antenna = "patch"
[[phases.runs.scenario.satellite]]
id = "LEO-1"
system = "generic-leo"
bands = ["L"]
max_elevation_deg = 80.0
tca_s = 450.0
altitude_km = 1080.0
inclination_deg = 53.0
[phases.runs.scenario.gnss]
constellation = "galileo"
band = "E1"

[[phases]]
name = "city-street-skyline"
duration_s = 900.0

[[phases.runs]]
series = [
  { channel = "gnss_error_m", unit = "m", t = "joint.epochs[].t_s", y = "joint.epochs[].error_gnss_m" },

  { channel = "leo_in_view", unit = "count", t = "joint.epochs[].t_s", y = "joint.epochs[].n_leo" },
]
